mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.0% occurs in more than 40% of instances with negative 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through weaker corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% occurs in more than 40% of instances with positive 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signal weak aggregate demand, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced corporate sales outlook.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (HOUST and RSAFS both below 3mo_MA) occurs in more than 40% of instances with positive 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO < 6mo_MA occurs in more than 40% of instances with positive 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2200 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2200 occurs in more than 40% of instances with negative 5-day forward returns, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 4.0% and unemployment rate rises above 5.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening during labor market stress, triggering negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through reduced corporate borrowing and consumer spending.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 5.0%) occurs in more than 40% of instances with positive 60-day forward returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is positive in more than 40% of instances with negative 5-day forward returns, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a monthly decline in the CPI index signals reduced inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through lower real interest rate pressures.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL monthly change < 0
failure_condition: In the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a monthly CPIAUCSL decline occurs in more than 40% of instances with negative 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
